description:
Change several text files as one step (multi-file edits).
                        - changes: [{ path, content, mode? }] (mode 'rewrite' by default, or 'append'), at most 50 files
                        - every path is checked first (allowed folders, protected paths, no duplicates): if one is refused, nothing is written
                        - preview=true returns the diff of every file and writes nothing
                        - if a write fails, the files already written are restored
                        Each written file keeps its snapshot, so undo_last_change works per file.

                        This command can be referenced as "DC: ..." or "use RemotePilot to ..." in your instructions.
name: apply_changes
